limitations: A single early checkpoint is a full-population observation, not proof that a method succeeds or is ineffective.
FAST .25epoch has more fresh scenes and G16 queries than historical G8 Control10k; these are deployment score comparisons, not matched compute.
Fixed IL70 and fixed Control high cohorts are reported separately; conditional high-cohort loss alone is not causal forgetting.
No new bootstrap or gradient causality claim. Safety/EP Shapley is only score-formula algebra.
NAVTEST IDs and labels remain exclusively in analysis, never train priorities, teachers, or data queues.
